top_signals.title: Australia Outraged as Israel Ends Probe of Aid Worker Death
top_signals.summary: Australia’s government said it is “outraged” that Israel failed to charge any of the soldiers responsible for the 2024 killing of an Australian aid worker, with Canberra formally protesting the decision.

top_signals.title: Stocks Waver as Treasury Rally Runs Out of Steam: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rebound in long-dated Treasuries ran out of steam while US stock futures struggled for direction as investors waited for fresh catalysts to give markets direction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Shein Seeks to Attract Boyu, UBS as IPO Cornerstone Investors
top_signals.summary: Asian private equity firm Boyu Capital and an asset management arm of UBS Group AG are among firms in talks to become cornerstone investors in Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s Hong Kong initial public offering, people familiar with the matter said.
